description: This file contains Python code defining functions and classes for generating C++ code related to JSON schema objects, including emitting enum and class definitions, handling restrictions, and managing code generation logic.

classes.name: Restrictions
classes.description: A class for managing and generating restriction conditions for JSON schema validation.

methods.name: IsObjectRestricted
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object or property has restrictions based on 'range' in schema.

methods.name: IsObjectOptionalOrOpaque
methods.description: Determines if a JSON object property is optional or opaque based on schema and parent properties.

methods.name: IsObjectOptional
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object property is optional, considering nested properties.

methods.name: ProcessEnums
methods.description: Processes enum objects for registration, optionally applying an action.

methods.name: EmitEnumRegs
methods.description: Generates C++ enum registration code for enums.

methods.name: EmitObjects
methods.description: Generates C++ class code for JSON objects, including enums, classes, constructors, and validation.
